title: Three-question claim-meaning diagnostic; no accuracy key
instructions: This is an unscored diagnostic profile, not the frozen 60-question benchmark.
The stronger field requirements are explicit development declarations and need review. Current claim roles cannot establish all of them.
Keep supported observations in their separate fields and retain unknown required answers. Do not substitute an observation for a stronger conclusion.
Do not read any private answer key, score output or previous investigation report.

questions.prompt: What application was used for e-mail communication?

x-claim-requirement.meaning: Product identity and version linked to the observed email communication. This diagnostic contract makes that requirement explicit.
x-claim-requirement.evidence_needed: Source-supported product/version identity and a supported relationship to the communication evidence; an executable basename alone is insufficient.

x-claim-requirement.meaning: Name observed in a program-run record.
x-claim-requirement.evidence_needed: A program-run observation.

x-claim-requirement.meaning: Path recorded by the program-run artifact.
x-claim-requirement.evidence_needed: A program-run observation.

questions.prompt: What files were copied from PC to CD-R? [Hint: Just use PC image only. You can examine transaction logs of the file system for this task.]

x-claim-requirement.meaning: Complete destination path tied to the requested copy/staging relationship.
x-claim-requirement.evidence_needed: A resolved historical ancestor chain and a supported copy/staging relationship. Path syntax or a journal observation alone is insufficient.

x-claim-requirement.meaning: Journal path observation, which may have unresolved ancestors.
x-claim-requirement.evidence_needed: A journal path observation; this is not a copy claim.

questions.prompt: What actions were performed for anti-forensics on PC at the last day ‘2015-03-25’?

x-claim-requirement.meaning: Time of the supported action, preserving its uncertainty.
x-claim-requirement.evidence_needed: Evidence and a supported rule connecting this action, target and time to the requested activity. A record-kind label, retained removal flag or program-run record alone does not establish purpose or wiping.
